name: Sarah M. Vahey
tagline: Top rated Family Law attorney in Joliet, Illinois
education: Northern Illinois University College of Law
about: Attorney Sarah M. Vahey is the a partner in the firm Vahey Law, & Medition, LLC in Joliet, Illinois. A top-rated lawyer with more than 12 years of experience, Ms. Vahey provides exceptional counsel and support to a diverse range of clients throughout the greater Chicagoland area and Will, DuPage, Cook and Kendall counties who have legal needs involving any of the following:

Over the course of her legal career, Ms. Vahey has achieved remarkable success guiding her clients through the divorce process and helping them make the best-informed decisions regarding child custody and support, spousal support, property division and all other related matters. She also serves as guardian ad litem in contentious child custody proceedings.

At all turns, Ms. Vahey delivers highly personalized counsel and dedicated support to those she serves. She strives to help her clients achieve their goals and the favorable outcomes they seek as efficiently and cost-effectively as possible. In recognition for her outstanding professionalism and service, Ms. Vahey has earned consistent top rankings and endorsements from her peers along with many excellent client reviews on Avvo and other sources. She has also received numerous testimonials and referrals from her satisfied clients.

A 2004 graduate of Drake University, Ms. Vahey attended Northern Illinois College of Law, where she obtained her Juris Doctor cum laude in 2008. She serves on the board of the Court Appointed Special Advocates of Will County, and she is an active member of the Will County Bar Association and the Illinois State Bar Association, among her other professional affiliations.
